requirement_text.REQ-367: See handoffs/WF02-REQ367-20260917/step-00-git-setup.json's context.requirement_text for the full verbatim requirement description -- not repeated here to keep this handoff shorter; read that file's context block in full before designing. Summary: new .github/workflows/cd.yml + new deploy/redeploy-qa.sh, adapting tvolodi/letflow-queue's proven SSH-restricted-key CD pattern for qa.bizdala.com. Two artefacts, not one (unlike letflow-queue's single-image case): the script must (1) git pull, (2) rebuild+recreate the backend Docker image via docker compose, (3) rebuild the frontend static bundle via a throwaway node:22 container with real VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY/VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID build args and atomically swap it into /opt/apps/letflow-qa/web-dist/ (backing up the previous build first), (4) health-check both. cd.yml must gate its deploy job on ci.yml's existing `changes` job's backend/frontend outputs -- do not duplicate diff logic. Credentials (SSH key, GH secrets) are explicitly OUT of scope -- this requirement only needs the workflow/script to exist, be correct, and reference not-yet-existing secret names. Do not touch deploy/redeploy-test.sh.

task.description:
WF-02 Step 1 -- Code design for REQ-367 (CD to QA on merge). Claim this handoff (status IN_PROGRESS). Read .github/workflows/ci.yml IN FULL (especially the `changes` job's path-filter outputs and job names) and deploy/redeploy-test.sh IN FULL (as the closest existing precedent for shape/conventions, even though it targets a different environment and must not be copied verbatim -- note its differences: different host/path/compose-project). Also read the sibling repo's pattern if reachable: tvolodi/letflow-queue's own .github/workflows/cd.yml and deploy/redeploy-test.sh, if this checkout has access to that repo locally (check c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow-queue or similar sibling path) -- if not locally available, design from this repo's own ci.yml/redeploy-test.sh precedent plus the requirement text's own detailed description of that pattern (SSH over a restricted deploy key, workflow_run trigger off ci.yml's completion, gated on the changes job's outputs).

This is infrastructure work (a bash script + a GitHub Actions YAML workflow), not Elixir application code -- adapt the design artefact's shape accordingly: instead of Ecto schemas/gen_statem specs, describe (1) deploy/redeploy-qa.sh's exact procedure as an ordered, numbered shell-script outline (each step's commands, in plain description, not full bash yet -- ELIXIR-DEV writes the actual script), including exact target paths (/opt/apps/letflow-qa/, web-dist/, backup naming), the docker compose invocation, the throwaway node:22 container invocation with build args, and both health-check commands; (2) .github/workflows/cd.yml's exact trigger mechanism (workflow_run on ci.yml completion, or documented equivalent), the job's conditional gate expression referencing ci.yml's changes job outputs, the SSH-action step referencing new, distinctly-named secret names (e.g. QA_DEPLOY_HOST/QA_DEPLOY_USER/QA_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY -- must NOT collide with letflow-queue's own secret names of the same shape), and the exact remote command it runs (invoking redeploy-qa.sh). State explicitly which secrets are referenced but not required to exist yet.

Write the design to lib/letflow/design/req367-cd-qa-deploy.md covering: (a) the numbered script procedure, (b) the workflow YAML structure/keys (not full YAML, a structural outline: triggers, jobs, gate condition, steps in order, secret names referenced), (c) exactly how the trigger avoids duplicating ci.yml's diff logic, (d) an explicit statement that deploy/redeploy-test.sh is left untouched and how the two scripts' relationship should be stated in cd.yml/redeploy-qa.sh's own header comments, (e) an explicit statement of what is and is NOT in scope (credentials excluded), (f) a section mapping each of REQ-367's 5 acceptance criteria (copied from step-00's handoff context) to a concrete design element, (g) an Open Questions section for anything not resolvable from available context (e.g., if the sibling letflow-queue repo's exact cd.yml is not locally readable, note that ELIXIR-DEV should still be able to implement from this design's own detail plus the pattern description in the requirement text -- do not silently invent unstated specifics; flag them).

No actual .sh or .yml code in the design doc -- structural outlines and command descriptions only, per the design-vs-implementation split CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR will check.

Complete the handoff: status COMPLETED, result.status PASS, artifacts_out: ["lib/letflow/design/req367-cd-qa-deploy.md"], next_action "Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 1b)". Commit the design file and completed handoff JSON on branch feature/WF02-REQ367-20260917, then push.

Secret names are named explicitly, distinctly from letflow-queue's own secret names, and stated as not-yet-required-to-exist
deploy/redeploy-test.sh's untouched status and its relationship to the new script is stated explicitly
No implementation code (.sh/.yml bodies) present -- structural/procedural description only
